scenes.interruption: Pop during push uses the current shared geometry and page surface; rapid close does not leave duplicate hero nodes.
scenes.accessibility: The card is a labelled button and the detail page has an explicit close control.
scenes.performance: Keep one geometry identity; animate transform, opacity, frame and radius without blur or decorative particle work.

scenes.interruption: Rapid add/remove keeps the latest state and starts the next layout transition from the currently rendered positions.
scenes.accessibility: Add, remove and rapid-test actions are independent buttons; layout change is not gesture-only.
scenes.performance: Animate a small row set with transitions; avoid per-frame resource creation and keep rows keyed by stable ids.

scenes.interruption: A new drag owns the card offset; release below threshold springs back from the current rendered transform and above threshold flies out.
scenes.accessibility: A reset button restores the stack without requiring a gesture.
scenes.performance: Use transform and opacity only; keep card count low and avoid blur or shadow recalculation during drag.

notes: Navigation push and pop run inside animateTo with the default transition disabled.
The list scene uses explicit animateTo plus per-row transition effects.
The card stack uses PanGesture plus springMotion and a velocity threshold fallback.
The list timing checkpoint uses peakMotionMs because the first visible frame is less stable after trigger injection.
